en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside or coastal area with a sandy road leading to a wooden bridge or pier, small boats on the water, wooden fences, and a cart wheel in the foreground. In the background are trees, village houses with red roofs, and the large gabled ruins of a stone church or monastery. Text is printed in the upper left in Russian and in the upper right in Estonian/English indicating the location.
